# Legal-attribution normalization — 2026-08-27

The CAM Initiative remains the public project name. Legal copyright, licensing, publication and permission authority is attributed to Dr Michelle O'Rourke.

This maintenance pass removes obsolete attribution to Aeon Governance Lab from repository citation/licensing surfaces and legacy public-interface citation strings. It does not rename the CAM Initiative, CAELESTIS or VIGIL projects, and it does not alter third-party source rights.
